title: Austin's Closed-Door Judge Interviews
summary:
*   The Municipal Court Sub-Committee convened for a special meeting, immediately entering a closed-door executive session.
*   A primary focus of the private session was interviewing candidates for vacant judicial positions at the Municipal Court.
*   Discussions in executive session also covered receiving legal advice, matters of land acquisition, and ongoing litigation.
*   No final votes or policy decisions were made by the committee during this particular meeting.
